title: When Is Enough Not Enough? Illusory Completion in Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2602.07549v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In agentic search, an LLM agent searches the web, reads the pages it finds, and decides what to look for next before returning an answer. But can we trust an answer simply because the agent returns it? Often not, and even a correct answer can be a lucky guess: on questions with several constraints, we find that agents conclude the task is complete while a constraint remains unverified in up to 48% of their correct answers. We call this illusory completion. To see how it arises, we introduce the Epistemic Ledger, which tracks at every turn what the retrieved pages establish about each constraint and what the agent claims. Across 13 agents, from 7B RL-trained models to frontier LLMs, training and scale raise accuracy but change the pattern of verification failures rather than eliminating them: constraints may be left unchecked, assumed without support, or retained despite refuting evidence. translated_title: 何时足够还不够？搜索智能体中的虚幻完成
translated_abstract: 在智能体搜索中，大语言模型智能体会搜索网络、阅读找到的页面，并决定接下来要查找什么，然后返回答案。但我们能仅凭智能体返回了答案就信任它吗？往往不能，即使是正确的答案也可能只是侥幸猜中：在包含多个约束条件的问题上，我们发现智能体在多达48%的正确答案中，会在某个约束条件尚未得到验证的情况下就断定任务已完成。我们将这种现象称为“虚幻完成”。为了探究其产生机制，我们提出了认知账本，它在每一轮中跟踪检索到的页面针对每个约束条件确立了什么信息，以及智能体声称了什么。在从7B强化学习训练模型到前沿大语言模型的13个智能体中，训练和规模提升了准确率，但只是改变了验证失败的模式，而非消除这些失败：约束条件可能未被检查、在没有依据的情况下被假定成立，或在存在反驳证据的情况下仍被保留。
tldr: 该研究揭示了搜索智能体中的“虚幻完成”现象——即使答案正确，智能体也可能在某个约束条件未经验证时就认为任务已完成（在正确答案中占比高达48%），并提出“认知账本”来追踪每轮检索对各约束条件的确立情况，发现训练和规模只能改变而非消除验证失败的模式。
en_tdlr: Search agents frequently exhibit "illusory completion"—declaring a task complete while a constraint remains unverified in up to 48% of correct answers—and the proposed Epistemic Ledger tracks what each retrieval establishes about every constraint, revealing that training and scale change the pattern of verification failures rather than eliminating them.
